versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the renfe skill for searching and booking Renfe trains in Spain (AVE, AVLO, regional, and more).
- Supports finding timetables, fares, and cheapest days as well as purchasing tickets via Bizum after user approval.
- Handles traveller setup, bookings, payment, and ticket downloads with clear user consent and security rules.
- Works on macOS and Linux with network and browser access; manages personal data securely.
- Integrates with the renfe CLI and guides user interactions step-by-step for searching, booking, and payment processes.
